During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''mission''' was carried out by [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. The renegades assaulted the Imperial [[Rori starship repair facility|starship repair facility]], but were repelled by a unit of [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]], who were repairing their own starship at the time.<ref name="TotC" />
